template_meta.name: Forest_Parting_Brand_Medallion
template_meta.description: Native trees physically part to form an organic, photographic bottle-shaped clearing (never a drawn or glowing silhouette) revealing a misty landscape and stream behind; a brand medallion matched to the client's real label design floats inside the gap.

user_inputs.brand_label_reference_image: [UPLOAD A PHOTO OF THE CLIENT'S REAL BOTTLE OR PRODUCT LABEL — required. Used as a second reference image so the model matches its exact colours, typography and ornament instead of inventing a new mark]
user_inputs.product_category_text: [INSERT PRODUCT CATEGORY — e.g. VODKA, GIN, WHISKEY]
user_inputs.specs_band_text: [INSERT SPEC BAND CONTENT — e.g. batch/region/ABV/volume, matching the real label's spec band]
user_inputs.primary_color_hex: [INSERT PRIMARY LABEL COLOR HEX — sampled from the real label]
user_inputs.accent_color_hex: [INSERT ACCENT LABEL COLOR HEX — sampled from the real label]
user_inputs.forest_type: [INSERT FOREST/LANDSCAPE TYPE — e.g. native bush, pine forest, birch forest]

rendering.style: photorealistic, dense {user_inputs.forest_type}, dappled natural light, atmospheric depth, single continuous photograph — not a graphic or composite
rendering.lighting: soft overcast daylight filtering through canopy
rendering.detail: trunks, ferns, hanging vines and canopy on both sides physically lean and curve away from the centre, interlacing overhead into a natural arch, as if a clearing has simply always existed in this grove; the gap they form must read as ordinary open air and daylight between real irregular trees, never as a crisp, drawn, or glowing outline

sections.shape: irregular, organic bottle-like clearing formed by real parted trees, symmetric only approximately about the vertical centre line — edges must look like tree trunks and foliage, not a geometric silhouette
sections.fill: nested photographic vignette, same light and colour grade as the surrounding forest, visible only through the gap

rendering.style: bright hazy daylight, sun visible low through the distant canopy of the clearing — natural light, not a stylised glow or glass effect
photorealistic misty {user_inputs.forest_type} valley receding into a still reflective lake, then a shallow stream running over moss-covered rocks
rendering.detail: landscape is simply seen through the gap between trees; depth increases toward the bottom

rendering.style: the stream from gap_landscape flows out from the base of the clearing, between foreground tree roots, into the real (non-gap) foreground rocks and undergrowth at the bottom of the canvas

sections.note: floats centred inside organic_clearing_gap; reproduces the exact colours, ornamental linework and typographic style of {user_inputs.brand_label_reference_image} as an engraved badge/medallion — never printed on a rendered bottle

elements.shape: circular badge outlined in {user_inputs.primary_color_hex}, with the same fine hand-etched border pattern as the reference label

elements.font_family: matches reference label arch typography, thin tracked-out caps
elements.path: arched, following the top inner curve of medallion_emblem

elements.note: sits inside a ribbon banner, matching reference label's ribbon style

elements.content: matches reference label's secondary ribbon text (e.g. country/region of origin)

elements.note: solid horizontal band matching reference label's lower spec band tone

sections.note: sits outside the clearing, over the foreground stream/rocks

generative_image_prompt: A 1080x1350px (4:5) full-bleed photorealistic advertising photograph — not a graphic, not a rendered object, a single continuous forest photo. The entire frame is a dense {user_inputs.forest_type}. The trees themselves physically part and lean away from the centre of the frame, their trunks, ferns, hanging vines and canopy curving and interlacing irregularly — as if a bottle-shaped clearing has simply always existed in this grove — leaving an organic gap between about 6% and 88% of canvas height: narrower at the top like a neck (trunks lean close together around 16-20% height), widening through the body (trees stand further back, roughly parallel, down to about 68% height), narrowing slightly again near the base before the treeline closes around 88% height. This gap is NOT a drawn silhouette, NOT a glowing object, NOT an outlined graphic shape — it is ordinary open air and daylight visible between real, irregular, overlapping tree trunks and foliage, photographed in the same light and colour grade as the surrounding trees. Within the gap: the top (6-30% height) is bright hazy daylight; the middle (30-70% height) recedes into a misty {user_inputs.forest_type} valley; the lower part (70-84% height) reveals a still reflective lake; a shallow stream flows out from the base of the clearing into the real foreground of moss-covered rocks at the bottom of the canvas. Centred inside the clearing, from about 38% to 80% height, reproduce the exact colour palette, ornamental linework and typography of the brand's real label — shown in the SECOND reference image ({user_inputs.brand_label_reference_image}) — as a floating engraved circular medallion badge in {user_inputs.primary_color_hex} and {user_inputs.accent_color_hex}: an arched wordmark '{user_inputs.brand_name}' along the top of the medallion; small caption '{user_inputs.tagline_caption}'; '{user_inputs.product_category_text}' in the reference label's bold slab-serif inside a ribbon banner; a second ribbon with the reference label's origin text; below the medallion a solid accent-coloured band reading '{user_inputs.specs_band_text}'; below that a small tracked line repeating '{user_inputs.tagline_caption}'. Outside the clearing, near the bottom over the foreground rocks and stream, small italic white text reads '{user_inputs.bottom_tagline}'. No literal bottle, glass, or product packaging is rendered anywhere, and the clearing itself must never look like a drawn or glowing shape — only real trees parting to reveal daylight and landscape, with the medallion's design matching the client's authentic label rather than an invented one. Mood: natural, premium, serene, misty. Two reference images are attached: the FIRST shows the compositional concept only (trees parting to form a bottle-shaped clearing) — do not copy its text, logo, or colours. The SECOND shows the brand's real product label — match its colours, typography and ornament exactly for the medallion, without rendering the bottle or glass itself. Output: 1080x1350px, 4:5, RGB, photorealistic, no watermarks.
